goal: Reproducir las figuras 3 y 4 de Lester 2023, mostrando la dispersión transversal espuria de los trackers convencionales frente al pseudo-simpléctico en un campo de invariantes exactos.
remote: scripts/remote --increment SF-32 (orchestrator only; mirror ~/MacroFlow3D-SF-32; single-flight per increment)

output_schema.labels_prefix: <prefix>.json (route metadata: route, field, eps|amplitude, n, h, vbar=1, gbar1=[0,1,0], gbar2=[0,0,1], r_F, e_v, e_psi1, e_psi2, min_abs_c_grid, exit_reason, iterations, wall_seconds, files) + <prefix>_u1.bin, <prefix>_u2.bin (raw little-endian double, n^3, layout i + n*(j + n*k), cell-centred fluctuations)

summary_json_keys.level: pollock: {delta_ratio, n_cells, delta}; rk: {tol, dt_max}; pseudo_symplectic: {tol_psi, ds}
summary_json_keys.stats: {delta_x2, delta_x3, delta_psi1, delta_psi2: {mean, var, rms, max_abs}; tau: {mean, var, min, max}} over status == 0
summary_json_keys.divergence_max_rel: pollock only: max |div| / max |u| of the face fluxes
summary_json_keys.min_abs_c_grid: min |grad psi1 x grad psi2| over the label grid cell centres (spline)

output_schema.histograms: analyze.py bins seeds.csv; 101 bins; ranges fixed: pollock [-0.75, 0.75], rk [-0.04, 0.04], pseudo_symplectic [-1e-9, 1e-9] (and an auto +-5 sigma panel)

nodes.title: Stokes face fluxes from the labels (StokesFaceVelocity)
nodes.objective: Create src/physics/particles/streamline_tracker/StokesFaceVelocity.{cuh,cu}: periodic MAC face averages of c = grad psi1 x grad psi2 on a grid of spacing Delta from ONE edge line integral per grid edge of psi1 (grad psi2 . t) with composite 4-point Gauss-Legendre on the spline knot intervals (exact for the degree-6 piecewise polynomial integrand), reused with opposite signs by the two faces sharing the edge (exactly divergence-free, eq. 33). GPU kernels + host mirror sharing the same __host__ __device__ edge-integral routine; POD PeriodicFaceFluxView; divergence diagnostic; add the .cu to STREAMLINE_TRACKER_SOURCES.
nodes.rationale: Eq. 32 of Lester 2023; with exact fluxes the only Pollock error is the RT0 interpolation (understanding.md 3.2).
deliverables: throwaway self-check numbers (S1-S6 of understanding.md 3.2) in the report, not committed
acceptance_criteria: one edge integral per edge, faces as signed sums (divergence algebraically zero)
composite GL4 on knot intervals; integrand degree argument documented in the header
face value = face AVERAGE (uniform pair gives u = 1)
periodic MAC layout documented: u[i,j,k] = face at x = i Delta of cell (i,j,k)
psi1 evaluated with the unwrapped coordinate of the edge (face's own x2)
host mirror == device to 1e-13
self-checks: S1 <= 1e-13 rel, S2 <= 1e-12 rel, S3 <= 1e-13, S4 1e-15, S5 spline-error level
no allocation in the evaluation kernels beyond output/edge buffers owned by a workspace
nvcc 11.4-safe (no nlohmann, C++17), builds wsl-debug, ctest -N stays 20

nodes.title: Pollock-type cellwise-linear tracker (PollockTracker)
nodes.objective: Create PollockTracker.{cuh,cu}: __host__ __device__ core on a PeriodicFaceFluxView (semi-analytical exits, exit coordinate set exactly, stagnation status 15, advance_to_x1 and advance_to_time, no fallback) and a GPU engine (one thread per particle, SF-31 particle bookkeeping, deterministic); add to STREAMLINE_TRACKER_SOURCES.
nodes.rationale: The conventional reconstruction-based tracker of Lester 2023 section 5.2 (understanding.md 3.3).
forbidden_scope: every other existing file (report N0 defects, do not edit)
deliverables: self-check numbers P1, P2, P3 (orders), P6
acceptance_criteria: exits per understanding.md 3.3 (log formula, A == 0 branch, stagnation when the velocity vanishes before the face)
exit coordinate SET exactly; ties advance both indices; integer wraps
advance_to_x1 lands exactly on a face target and in closed form inside a cell
status 15 kStatusPollockStagnation documented; 12 and 14 reused
host core == GPU bitwise
no allocation/sync in the step kernels
P1 exact, P2 at spline-error level, P3 monotone with order >= 0.8

nodes.title: Return-map instrument: label routes + pseudo-symplectic and RK return maps
nodes.objective: Create apps/spurious_spreading/ (executable spurious_spreading, documented-experiment instrument, not a ctest): subcommands solve-labels (frozen stack on an analytic field, ev_ladder recipe, saves u1/u2 .bin + metadata), analytic-labels (parameterized pair G), return-map --tracker pseudo_symplectic|rk (first return of unwrapped x1 to x1_0 + 1 by bisection on the last panel/chunk from a saved state, SF-31 cores unmodified; N_p hash seeds on x1 = 0; seeds.csv + summary.json per the schema); a --tracker pollock stub that exits 3 'not available' until N2b.
required_context: tests/streamline_tracker/analytic_pairs.hpp (read only; copy pair G parameterized into the app)
expected_write_scope: CMakeLists.txt (add_executable spurious_spreading + link + compile options; no add_test)
deliverables: self-check: pair U and A at 16^3 (delta = 0 / spline level, tau = 1)
acceptance_criteria: schema exactly as output_schema
landing |x1_u - 1| <= 1e-12 or reported
seeds identical across trackers/levels (inject_box with the given seed)
label routes write/read bitwise round trip
solve-labels prints r_F, e_v, min|c| and accepts any exit reason, recording it
no nlohmann in .cu, C++17, nvcc 11.4-safe
byte-reproducible outputs across two runs
validation_commands: local smokes at 16^3/32^3 (analytic labels only; the stack solve is NOT run locally beyond 16^3 homogeneous smoke)
